rigsession.lost_reconnect_mine: Connection lost: {cause}. Your transmission is cut by the station. Reconnecting automatically for {seconds} s.
rigsession.bye: The station is closing the connection: {reason}
rigsession.protocol_mismatch: The station speaks protocol {station}, the app speaks {app}: receive and STOP only. Update the app or the station.
rigsession.reconnected_one: Reconnected after {seconds} s ({n} attempt). Turn “Transmit allowed” back on to transmit.
rigsession.reconnected_other: Reconnected after {seconds} s ({n} attempts). Turn “Transmit allowed” back on to transmit.
rigsession.bug_report_sent: Report sent to the station: it will be attached to the troubleshooting report (TRX Console, menu 6.3).
rigsession.no_response: No response from the station to “{cmd}”.
rigsession.power_on_no_response: Cannot power on: no response from the station
rigsession.protocol_unknown_tx: Unknown protocol version: transmitting impossible (STOP still allowed).
rigsession.selcall_update_station: SELCALL call: station needs updating (0.63.0 or later).
rigsession.selcall_arm_first: Turn on “Transmit allowed” first: a SELCALL call is a transmission.
rigsession.selcall_not_armed: Arm SELCALL on a code first.
rigsession.protocol_unknown_memories: Unknown protocol version: memories are read-only.
rigsession.protocol_unknown_settings: Unknown protocol version: settings impossible (STOP still allowed).
texts.loss_auth: Credentials refused (or too many attempts: wait a few minutes)
texts.loss_refused: Access refused by the station (account disabled or expired, visitors full, operator absent)
texts.loss_pin: Certificate fingerprint is DIFFERENT: this may not be your station, connection blocked
texts.loss_untrusted: Station certificate not recognised: enter its fingerprint (TRX Console, menu 4.1) or scan its QR code
driving.ptt_hint: While driving, the on-screen PTT is disabled: transmit from the car screen, the steering-wheel buttons or a Bluetooth button (setting “PTT by button”). STOP is always available.
headsetmic.button_end: Headset button (or headset lost): end of transmission.
headsetmic.no_call_mode: The headset did not switch to call mode within {seconds} s: back to receive (mic kept closed).
help.nr: Transceiver noise reduction. Tap: on / off. Long press: reduction level (NR / NB window).
help.nb: Impulse noise blanker (ignition, electric fences). Tap: on / off. Long press: level.
help.preamp: Transceiver receive preamplifier. Tap: next step (off, P.AMP 1, P.AMP 2 depending on the rig). Useful on the high bands; turn off if strong signals overload.
help.att: Transceiver input attenuator. Tap: on / off. Reduces all signals (strong nearby station, busy low bands); turns off the preamplifier.
help.notch: Transceiver notch filter against a carrier or whistle. Tap: automatic, then manual, then off.
help.agc: Automatic gain control: how fast the gain recovers after a strong signal (fast, medium, slow). Tap: next speed.
help.fil: Receive filter width. Tap: next filter (FIL1, FIL2, FIL3 on an Icom, otherwise the widths declared by the rig).
help.pwr: Transceiver transmit power. Tap: choose the power (never above the station's limit).
help.aip: IP+ (Icom): better handling of strong signals at the cost of a little sensitivity. Tap: on / off.
help.comp: Transceiver speech compressor (SSB): denser, more “punchy” voice. Tap: on / off. Watch the ALC.
help.rit: Receive clarifier: shifts the receive frequency without changing the transmit frequency. Tap: on / off; adjust with the slider below the squelch, tap the value to return to 0.
help.xit: ΔTX (XIT): shifts the TRANSMIT frequency. The station checks the band on the frequency actually transmitted. Tap: on / off.
help.tuner: Transceiver automatic antenna tuner. Tap: on / off.
help.sel: Station SELCALL: selective calling in SSB. “SEL 4721” = waiting on this code (audio muted), “SEL OPEN” = call received. Tap: SELCALL panel.
help.bzh: Breizh Audio Box: processing chain for the transmitted voice. Green = ready, orange = fallback to direct, grey = absent. Tap: its window.
help.fdv: FreeDV RADE V1 decoded by the station. Green = voice received, orange = searching for a signal or restarting, red = decoders abandoned (rig audio restored), grey = rig audio. Tap: its window.
help.wf: Small HF waterfall on the Station tab. Tap: show / hide.
help.hf: Transceiver HF spectrum, sent by the station: it uses bandwidth. Hide it on 4G / 5G to save data.
help.son: Spectrum of the received audio, computed on this device: no network data, a little battery.
help.step: Tuning step of the − and + buttons. Tap: next step.
help.arm: Transmit allowed: two-step safety. While it is off, the PTT has no effect. Always off after connecting.
help.mute: Mutes the received audio on this device (the station keeps receiving).
mobilefeatures.always: Always shown: mic, PTT, STOP, arming, TOT countdown and safety banners.
settings.language_tx: The language cannot be changed during a transmission.
replayhub.not_granted: Replay not granted by the station.
replayhub.tx_in_progress: A transmission is already in progress.
righub.password_on_phone: Password to be entered on the phone.
righub.car_start_refused: Android refuses to connect from the car: open openRemoteTRX on the phone.
righub.left_during_tx: App closed during transmission: back to receive.
rigmedia.lock_unknown: Car: transmit state unknown (station not connected).
rigmedia.lock_tx: Car: transmitting; END TX with the mic button, or STOP.
rigmedia.lock_rx_only: Car: receive only, transmitting is impossible from this phone.
rigmedia.voice_not_understood: Car: “{text}” not understood (memory, band or frequency).
rigservice.car_rx_only: Receive only: Android refuses the mic from the car (open the app on the phone to transmit).
rigservice.car_start_refused: Android refuses to connect from the car: open openRemoteTRX on the phone.
rigservice.media_key_end: Headset or steering-wheel button ({name}): end of transmission.
rigservice.media_key_request: Headset or steering-wheel button ({name}): transmit request.
rigservice.headset_needs_android12: Android 12 or later required: transmitting refused while this setting is on
rigservice.headset_ready: headset ready: {device} (mic used during transmission only)
rigservice.no_headset: no Bluetooth headset connected: transmitting refused while this setting is on
rigservice.route_needs_android12: Headset mic: Android 12 or later required: back to receive.
rigservice.route_no_headset: Headset mic chosen, but no Bluetooth headset connected: back to receive.
rigservice.route_refused: Android refuses the headset mic: back to receive.
rigservice.focus_busy: Audio busy with a call or another app: receive muted meanwhile.
rigservice.focus_lost_tx: Audio taken by a call or another app: back to receive.
rigservice.focus_lost_muted: Audio taken by a call or another app: receive muted meanwhile.
rigservice.focus_lost_continue: Another app took the audio: reception continues.
rigservice.channel_description: Link and transmit state, STOP button
rtclink.eq_unavailable: Equalizer unavailable on this phone ({error}): voice unprocessed.
spatialhub.bt_call_mode: Bluetooth headset in call mode: stereo unavailable
spatialhub.stereo_unavailable: Stereo output unavailable on this phone.
voicehub.breizh_scrambler_refused: Breizh Audio Box in use: transmit scrambler impossible (mutually exclusive). Choose “Direct” in Breizh to scramble.
voicehub.mic_denied: Mic not allowed: allow it in the Android settings.
voicehub.mic_busy: Mic unavailable (in use by another app?).
rigparts.link_lost: LINK LOST: reconnecting for {seconds} s more (attempt {attempts})
rigparts.link_lost_tx_cut: Any transmission is cut by the station.
rigparts.protocol_unknown: Unknown protocol version: receive and STOP only.
rigparts.replay_playing: PLAYING THE RECORDING: {position} / {length} s — STOP to stop
rigparts.fault: FAULT at the station ({fault}): action required.
rigparts.passenger: Car connected: passenger mode (on-screen PTT allowed).
rigdialogs.no_levels: The rig declares no adjustable level for NR or NB.
rigdialogs.name: Name
rigdialogs.bands_hint: Tick your bands and put them in the order you want. None ticked: all.
tabletlayout.hf_hidden: HF spectrum hidden: the station no longer sends it (saves data).
audiowaterfallview.title: Audio spectrum
settingstab.keep_screen_on: Keep the screen on while connected
settingstab.keep_tx: Keep transmitting when leaving the app (otherwise: back to receive)
settingstab.driving: Driving mode (reduced screen, touch PTT disabled)
settingstab.driving_auto: Automatic driving mode when a car is connected (Android Auto)
featuresviews.title: Mobile features
featuresviews.hint: What the app shows, on this phone only. Hiding stops nothing: a feature in use stays shown.
presenceviews.kick_text: They can reconnect; to prevent it, disable their account on the station (TRX Console, menu 4.2).
presenceviews.close_text: The {count} connected visitor(s) will be disconnected.
friendsviews.block_switch: “Friends” block on the Station tab (instead of the small waterfall and the bands)
friendsviews.relay_note: The presence relay only sees encrypted states; a QSY to a friend is done in receive, after confirmation, never during a transmission.
friendsviews.exclude_confirm: Exclude {pseudo}? A new key is given to the other members: {pseudo} will no longer read anything from the group.
friendsviews.create_note: You will be its administrator; then invite your friends (“Invite”).
friendsviews.invite_valid: Valid 7 days, for ONE station only. It contains the group key: give it only to the invited person.
monitoringscreen.privacy_note: The helped station sends what ITS operator chose, always masked and encrypted through the relay. The helping station can only read and ask; nothing controls the rig.
netviews.title: Link with the station
netviews.export_chooser: Send the export to the development team
netviews.orange_lt_red: Orange must be lower than red.
netviews.permission_denied: Permission denied: only signal levels are recorded.
netviews.cells_note: Helps explain a dropout in the car. Android requires it: location permission, used only for the cell tower ID; no position is read or sent. App open only. Without it, the network type and signal level are recorded anyway.
problemreportdialog.describe: Describe what happened (what you were doing, what you expected, what occurred). The full report will be shown to you before sending.
problemreportdialog.exactly: This is EXACTLY what will be sent to the station (no password):
spatialdialog.intro: Makes the received audio stereo on headphones: listening comfort, voice in the centre, hiss around it. Processed on this phone only: the station still sends mono audio.
breizhdialog.next_tx: Settings apply to the next transmission, never during one. This phone's equalizer, chorus, reverb and scrambler are off when the voice goes through Breizh.
clusterandbeeps.no_spot: No active spot yet (spots less than 15 min old).
clusterandbeeps.beeps_intro: Generated and TRANSMITTED by the station; setting shared by all devices.
clusterandbeeps.media_ptt: PTT by the headset button or the steering-wheel buttons (Play/Pause)
clusterandbeeps.media_ptt_hint: Press = start or end of transmission, never a hold; “Transmit allowed” is still required; automatic playback when a headset connects is ignored.
clusterandbeeps.headset_mic_hint: Used during transmission only (the headset switches to call mode: speak after the beep). During transmission, the headset button ends it. Without a headset, transmitting is refused. Takes effect at the next connection.
clusterandbeeps.android_auto_hint: In the car: “openRemoteTRX” player (Play = listen, Pause = mute), TRANSMIT / STOP / Allow transmit buttons, Browse > Stations, Memories, Bands, and voice, in French for now (“mémoire 40 mètres”, “fréquence 7 074”, “bande 20 mètres”: never transmitting by voice). The steering-wheel buttons only act as PTT with the setting above. App installed by hand: in Android Auto, Settings > version (tap 10 times) > Developer settings > “Unknown sources”.
clusterandbeeps.mic_hint: Voice dropouts when transmitting: try “quiet room” or a “headset mic” profile (noise reduction off). Takes effect at the next connection.
stationscreen.not_pairing_qr: This QR code is not an openRemoteTRX pairing QR code (TRX Console, menu 4.1).
stationscreen.qr_read: Station read from the QR code: enter the password, then “Connect”.
stationscreen.qr_fingerprint_updated: Station already known: certificate fingerprint UPDATED from the QR code.
stationscreen.no_qr_in_image: No QR code found in this image: crop it to the QR code (sharp, complete, no glare) or scan it.
stationscreen.scan_prompt: QR code from TRX Console menu 4.1
stationscreen.image_wide: Read the QR code from an image
stationscreen.name: Name
stationscreen.keep_password: Remember the password (encrypted on this device)
stationscreen.fingerprint_hint: Empty only behind an HTTPS proxy with a recognised certificate.
stationscreen.err_address: Invalid address: host or IP, optional port (8443), HTTPS only.
voicescreen.save_profile_hint: Current equalizer, chorus and reverb, stored on the station for this account (same name = replaced).
voicescreen.delete_profile_hint: It is removed from the station, for the page and the app of this account.
voicescreen.eq_breizh: Off: the voice goes through Breizh Audio Box.
voicescreen.eq_on: On: applied to your voice when transmitting.
voicescreen.eq_off: Off: voice sent as is (limiter only).
voicescreen.limiter: Limiter always on (peaks at {limit} dBFS). Check the ALC on a dummy load after any change.
voicescreen.mic_level_hint: Level shown during a recording (below) or a transmission.
voicescreen.gate: Noise gate (30 dB attenuation below the threshold, never silent)
voicescreen.show_details: Frequency and Q of each band
voicescreen.fx_warning: Not recommended in SSB: they reduce intelligibility. Cut off at the end of each transmission.
voicescreen.listen_hint: Record a few seconds (30 s at most), then play them back with the current settings, adjustable during playback. Never sent to the station; impossible during a transmission (any keying stops it). Headphones recommended.
voicescreen.share_hint: Same format as the web page: the same voice on the PC and the phone.
voicescreen.scrambler_warning:
The scrambler makes your voice unintelligible to anyone without the same setting. It is NOT encryption: anyone with an identical scrambler can hear you.

On the amateur radio bands, the Radio Regulations (ITU, Art. 25) and national regulations prohibit transmissions intended to obscure the meaning of messages. You take FULL responsibility.
voicescreen.scrambler_hint: Disabled at every start. Same mode on both sides; added delay: about 43 ms. SELCALL tones and station beeps are not scrambled.
voicescreen.scramble_tx_breizh: Scramble my transmission (impossible: the voice goes through Breizh)
voicescreen.scrambler_tuning: SSB reception still scrambled: adjust the fine offset (or the rig's RIT). Test without transmitting: “Play back” (above) lets you hear your scrambled voice; with “Descramble” too, it should become clear again.
voicescreen.replay_hint: Records the received audio ({seconds} s at most), then transmits it again. Mic off during playback, listen on the phone. Rebroadcasting a station to third parties is generally prohibited: at your own responsibility.
freedvdialog.activity_intro_operator: From FreeDV Reporter (qso.freedv.org), read by the station as a mere observer: nothing is sent. Score = chance of reception here (RADE V1): stations transmitting, neighbours decoding. Tap a frequency to go there (USB if the rig is not in upper sideband).
hfscopeview.title: HF spectrum
hfscopeview.qsy_impossible: QSY impossible: transmission in progress or station disconnected.
hfscopeview.display: Display (phone, shared with the large spectrum)
selcallpanel.intro: Station digital squelch by group call: armed on a code, it mutes the received audio until a station of the group sends that code, then keeps it open until you re-arm.
selcallpanel.update_station: SELCALL call and end frame: station needs updating (0.63.0 or later).
selcallpanel.send_on_tx_end: Send the frame at the end of transmission (instead of the roger beep; transmitted by the station)
selcallpanel.arm_first: Turn on “Transmit allowed”: a SELCALL call is a transmission.
selcallpanel.calibrate_help: Transmits a tone for up to 18 s (rig power): on a dummy load or a clear frequency. Cancel = STOP.
selcallpanel.calibrate_help_last:
Transmits a tone for up to 18 s (rig power): on a dummy load or a clear frequency. Cancel = STOP.
Last adjustment: {calibration}
selcallpanel.test_help: Made here: 2 s of silence then the frame 3 times. Send it as a DOCUMENT (not as a voice message); the other operator plays it into their rig's mic, medium volume, while transmitting, and identifies.
swrscreen.intro: A short FM carrier per point (normal transmission: “Transmit allowed”, STOP always possible), tuner off, then the rig is restored.
swrscreen.arm_first: “Transmit allowed” must be on (at the bottom of the main screen).
swrscreen.outside_text: This range is outside the amateur radio bands: you are about to transmit outside these bands, at your sole responsibility.
swrscreen.fix_by_hand: If a setting was not restored, correct it by hand.
swrscreen.caption: Image caption
settings.language_next: Screens change right away; the station gets the new language at the next connection.
